scripts.sync-images: powershell -Command "$changes = aws s3 sync ./public s3://americandefensealliance --delete --cache-control 'public, max-age=0, must-revalidate' --exclude '*.pdf' --output text --profile ada; if ($changes) { $paths = ($changes | Select-String 'upload:' | ForEach-Object { if($_ -match 'public\\(.+?) to') { '/' + $matches[1].Replace('\\', '/') } }); if ($paths) { Write-Host 'Creating CloudFront invalidation for:'; Write-Host $paths; aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E15R7SXII9T1VC --paths $paths --profile ada } }"
scripts.sync-metadata: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Path './public/events' -Recurse -Filter 'metadata.json' | ForEach-Object { $relPath = $_.FullName.Replace((Get-Location).Path + '\public\events\', '').Replace('\', '/'); $s3Path = 's3://americandefensealliance/events/' + $relPath; Write-Host 'Uploading:' $_.FullName 'to' $s3Path; aws s3 cp $_.FullName $s3Path --cache-control 'public, max-age=0, must-revalidate' --profile ada }; $invalidationPaths = (Get-ChildItem -Path './public/events' -Recurse -Filter 'metadata.json' | ForEach-Object { '/events/' + $_.FullName.Replace((Get-Location).Path + '\public\events\', '').Replace('\', '/') }); if ($invalidationPaths) { Write-Host 'Creating CloudFront invalidation for:'; Write-Host $invalidationPaths; aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E15R7SXII9T1VC --paths $invalidationPaths --profile ada }"
scripts.sync-event-assets: powershell -Command "if (-not $env:npm_config_event) { Write-Error 'Usage: npm run sync-event-assets --event=2026DTAPC'; exit 1 }; $event = $env:npm_config_event; $source = './public/events/' + $event; if (-not (Test-Path $source)) { Write-Error ('Event folder not found: ' + $source); exit 1 }; aws s3 sync $source ('s3://americandefensealliance/events/' + $event) --cache-control 'public, max-age=0, must-revalidate' --profile ada; aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E15R7SXII9T1VC --paths ('/events/' + $event + '/*') --profile ada"
scripts.sync-event-csv: powershell -Command "if (-not $env:npm_config_event) { Write-Error 'Usage: npm run sync-event-csv --event=2026DTAPC'; exit 1 }; $event = $env:npm_config_event; $file = './public/events/' + $event + '/registration-information.csv'; if (-not (Test-Path $file)) { Write-Error ('CSV not found: ' + $file); exit 1 }; aws s3 cp $file ('s3://americandefensealliance/events/' + $event + '/registration-information.csv') --cache-control 'public, max-age=0, must-revalidate' --profile ada; aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E15R7SXII9T1VC --paths ('/events/' + $event + '/registration-information.csv') --profile ada"
